title: Microsomal binding (fu_mic) correction for the P29.2 well-stirred CL arm
scored_split: train (no-fit == leave-one-drug-out over the 15 train drugs with human liver CLint, human fu and human IV CL truth)
fu_mic_equation: Hallifax-Houston 2006 (PMID 16552024): fu_mic = 1/(1 + C*10^(0.072*logP^2 + 0.067*logP - 1.126)); logP = ChEMBL_37 ALOGP; C = 1.0 mg/mL declared default (Austin 2002, PMID 12433825)

heldout.note: Held-out truth is absent from the sandbox clone; the host scores the 6 held-out IVIVE drugs with full truth via score_heldout_fu_mic(). Physchem (logP/pKa) is provided for all 6 so the correction is exercised, not inert.
